name: Chatwoot
description: Self-hosted customer support and live-chat platform, an alternative to Zendesk or Intercom.

ram_min_mb.quote: 4GB RAM is the required minimum memory size and supports up to 10,000 conversations a day
ram_min_mb.scope: Official self-hosted deployment, general, up to 10,000 conversations/day workload tier

cpu_rec_cores.quote: 4 cores is the recommended minimum number of cores and supports up to 10,000 conversations a day
cpu_rec_cores.scope: Official self-hosted deployment, general, up to 10,000 conversations/day workload tier; doc labels this a recommended-minimum guidance figure, not a hard floor

no_official_figure.note: Docs give one required RAM minimum (4GB) and one recommended-minimum CPU figure (4 cores) for the base workload tier. The 8-core/8GB figures are a higher-conversation-volume scaling tier, not a general recommended baseline above the stated minimums (Defect Class #2) — not harvested as rec/min counterparts.
